issues.description: Function name mismatch for the logical-zero state preparation routine: the problem statement asks students to implement a function named '_construct_zero_state_prep_circuit(Hx: npt.NDArray[np.int8], offset: int=0) -> stim.Circuit' while both the provided template and the reference solution define and use 'construct_zero_state_prep_circuit(...)' (no leading underscore). This inconsistency between the problem text and the code will confuse students about which identifier to implement and can cause automated graders or tests that follow the problem text literally to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the function name consistent across all artifacts. Preferred fix: update the problem statement to request 'construct_zero_state_prep_circuit(Hx: npt.NDArray[np.int8], offset: int=0) -> stim.Circuit' (remove the leading underscore) so it matches the template and solution. Alternatively, rename the function in both the template and solution to '_construct_zero_state_prep_circuit' and update any tests accordingly.
